records.source: Is... Is that for me?$u#$b#Wow! This exactly what I wanted... Thank you! You're so nice!$h
records.translation: P... Para sa akin ba iyan?$u#$b#Aba! Iyan mismo ang gusto ko... Salamat! Napakabait mo!$h

records.source: Welcome to the Trout Derby! What can I do for you?
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa Derbi ng Trutsa! Ano ang maitutulong ko sa iyo?

records.source: During this event, Rainbow Trout have a chance of carrying a 'Golden Tag'. If you find one, turn it in here for a prize!
records.translation: Sa okasyong ito, maaaring may dalang 'Ginintuang Tatak' ang Trutsang Bahaghari. Kung makakita ka nito, ibigay mo rito kapalit ng premyo!

records.source: Looks like your bag's full. Better make some room first.
records.translation: Mukhang puno ang bag mo. Maglaan ka muna ng espasyo.

records.source: Seems like you don't have any Golden Tags... better get fishing!
records.translation: Mukhang wala kang Ginintuang Tatak... mangisda ka muna!

records.source: The Annual Trout Derby has begun.
records.translation: Nagsimula na ang taunang Derbi ng Trutsa.
Nagsimula na ang Pista ng Pusit.

records.source: The Desert Festival is now open!
records.translation: Bukas na ang Pista sa Disyerto!

records.source: Welcome to SquidFest! What can I do for you?
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa Pista ng Pusit! Ano ang maitutulong ko sa iyo?

records.source: It's a squid fishing challenge! If you can hit our daily catch targets, you'll win prizes. Check the sign to the left. We also put special bait in the water so the squid are active all day!
records.translation: Hamon ito sa pangingisda ng pusit! Kung maaabot mo ang arawang target sa dami ng huli, mananalo ka ng mga premyo. Tingnan ang karatula sa kaliwa. Naglagay rin kami ng espesyal na pain sa tubig upang maging aktibo ang mga pusit buong araw!

records.source: You haven't earned any rewards yet. Better start catching some squid!
records.translation: Wala ka pang nakukuhang gantimpala. Manghuli ka muna ng mga pusit!

records.source: You don't have any rewards available right now. Keep catching more squid!
records.translation: Wala kang makukuhang gantimpala sa ngayon. Patuloy kang manghuli ng mas maraming pusit!

records.source: Congratulations! You hit our iridium-level target and earned all possible rewards for today.
records.translation: Binabati kita! Naabot mo ang aming target na antas-iridyum at nakuha ang lahat ng gantimpala para sa araw na ito.
Kailangan ng mas maluwag na lugar upang maitayo.

records.source: A green rain has descended upon the valley.
records.translation: Bumuhos ang berdeng ulan sa lambak.

records.source: Only a master of the five ways may enter. ({0}/5)
records.translation: Tanging dalubhasa sa limang landas ang maaaring pumasok. ({0}/5)

records.source: You've got some new ideas to sleep on...
records.translation: May mga bago kang ideyang pag-iisipan bago matulog...
